# Recon map: Slotly (web)

Scope: the public booking page and the guest booking flow
For: freelancers who hate per-seat pricing
Date: 2026-10-20

## Screens

| ID | screen | route / how to reach | purpose | key components | states seen |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 | booking page | /u/<host>/<event> | guest picks a day | day strip, slot grid | empty week, filled, loading |
| S02 | pick a time | same page, day chosen | guest picks a slot | slot grid, timezone picker | no slots, filled |
| S03 | details form | same page, slot chosen | name and email | form, confirm button | error, filled |
| S04 | confirmed | /booked/<id> | the receipt | summary card, add-to-calendar | default |

## Flows

```
FL01 Guest books a slot
    S01 -> S02 -> S03 -> S04
    happy path clicks: 4
    edge: no slots this week, time zone differs, slot taken while filling the form
```

## Components

| component | variants | states | used on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Slot button | default, taken | default, hover, focus, disabled | S02 |

content.text:
Top three complaints, from 9 rows in `reviews.csv`:

1. **Pricing, especially per-seat: 6 reviews.** "Per-seat pricing killed it for our team of three." (Reddit)
2. **Bugs and reliability: 3 reviews.** These cover crashes, double-booking and wrong time zones. "Booked twice for the same slot and the client was furious." (App Store)
3. **Missing features: 2 reviews.** These ask for SMS reminders and buffer times. "No way to set buffer times between meetings." (G2)

For your call:
- **Duplicate removed:** Rows 2 and 9 are the same Google Play review, so I counted it once. Counting it twice would make pricing 7. It would also make "support never replied" 2, which would tie it with missing features for third place.
- **Tiny sample:** Nine rows is too few to call this statistically meaningful. Say "early signal" on the call, not "most users."
- **Missing links:** Two rows have no URL (the "Expensive and buggy" review and the Reddit per-seat review), so I couldn't check their sources.
- **Pricing and your pitch:** The Slotly recon notes target freelancers who hate per-seat pricing. That matches the top complaint.
